items.q: And, of course, Claude Rhodes was the pianist. McKinney didn't do nothing but take care of the business... McKinney formed this Septet.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, June Jim Cole. Todd
And, of course, Claude Rhodes was the pianist. McKinney didn't do nothing but take care of the business.

Originally there was four pieces before it got to be the Septet. McKinney was a drummer and Milt Senior's father had a little orchestra around home. So Cuba, they got Cuba Austin also a drummer, they got him from a carnival that came through. And McKinney formed this Septet.
